tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnatak

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All declarations shall be made on Rs.500.00 Notarized Stamp Paper and shall have enquiry no. and date of declarations
Liquid Asset Certificate shall have Name and Contact details (Mobile No. and Email ID) of Issuing Authority and Tender Enquiry No
Certified copies of Profit and Loss Statement / Balance Sheet should have UDIN of Chartered Accountant certifying the statement

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should be in existence as any of the following: a) Company incorporated in India under the Companies Act, 1956/2013 including any amendment thereto b) LLP incorporated in India under the Limited Liability Partnership (LLP) Act, 2008 including any amendment thereto c) Partnership Firm under Partnership Act, 1932 in India d) Sole Proprietorship Concern. Documents to be uploaded: a) i. Certificate of Incorporation issued by Registrar of Companies as per Companies Act 1956/2013 along with Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association of the Company.ii. Declaration from Directors of the Company in MBP-1 Form stating that they are not disqualified to be a Director of the Company along with the list of Companies in which they are Directors as on the date of inviting tender (s). b) i. Certification of Incorporation issued by Registrar of Companies as per LLP Act 2008. ii. Limited Liability Partnership Agreement of LLP. c) i. Partnership Deed, GST Registration certificate. ii. Shops & Establishment Registration certificate, as applicable. d) PAN/GST Registration certificate

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- QR-1 As Per Tender Document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder shall be a reputed manpower providing agency having valid registration certificate issued by Department of Labour, GOK for providing manpower services.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- QR-2 As Per Tender Document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should have obtained orders for having provided at least 80 percent of the tendered quantity of drivers for Light/Heavy Vehicles to reputed organizations like PSUs, GOVT /DISCOMS - in any one of the last three years 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 as on the date of opening of the bid..Purchase Order along with Order completion copies placed by Govt./DISCOMs & PSUs, shall be uploaded

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- QR-3 As Per Tender Document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should furnish the performance certificate issued by the officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer/DGM or equivalent officer of the concerned departments for having provided manpower services for at least 80% of the tendered quantity in any one of the last three years i.e., 2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25 and provided services for satisfactory operation for one year as on the date of bid opening.The performance certificates issued by the officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer/DGM or equivalent officer of the concerned departments shall be furnished, failing which the offer will be disqualified.

The Bidder shall have PF, ESI, Insurance, GST Certificate, Workmen Compensation Act and Factory Act Registration with the Competent Authority and proof of such Registration shall be enclosed along with the bid.The following details shall be uploaded.a.EPF Registration Number with date,b.ESI Registration Number with date.c.Bidders PAN Card Number.d.GST registration Number with date, allotted by tax authorities. valid Labour License issued by labour department and it should be in force, duly indicating the period of validity

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- QR-5 As Per Tender Document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should not be under Default/debarred/Blacklisted from participating in a Tender by any Electricity Distribution Companies or Govt. Electrical Utilities/PSUs, as on the date of submission of bids. Scanned copy of the self-declaration on notarized stamp paper of Rs.500/- by the Bidder adhering to this clause shall be uploaded. The self-declaration shall clearly indicate the tender enquiry number and date on which declaration is don

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- QR-8 As Per Tender Document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Litigation History:The Bidder should provide detailed information on any litigation or arbitration arising out of contracts completed or under execution by it over the preceding five years, a consistent history of awards involving litigation against the Bidder or any partner may result in rejection of Bid. Scanned copy of the self-declaration on notarized stamp paper of Rs.500/- shall be uploaded. The self-declaration shall clearly indicate the tender enquiry number and date on which declaration is done

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- QR-9 As Per Tender Document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Any Bidder from a country which shares a land with India will be eligible to bid in this tender only if the Bidder is registered with the Competent Authority.(As per Government Order No. FD 455 Exp-12/2020 dated 25.08.2020.) Scanned copy of Self-declaration on notarized stamp paper of Rs.500/- shall be uploaded regarding Boarder sharing or not. If the Bidder is from a country which shares a land with India, Registration certificate issued by the competent authority shall be uploaded. The self-declaration shall clearly indicate the tender enquiry number and date on which declaration is done.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- QR-10 As Per Tender Document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: A certificate for having read the clauses is required to be submitted/uploaded by the Bidder separately in the following format: I have read the clause regarding restrictions on procurement from a Bidder of a country which shares a land border with India. I certify that this Bidder is not from such a country or, if from such a country, has been registered with the Competent Authority. I hereby certify that this Bidder fulfils all requirements in this regard and is eligible to be considered. (Where applicable, evidence of valid registration by the Competent Authority shall be attached.) Scanned copy of the self-declaration in the prescribed format on notarized stamp paper of Rs.500/- shall be uploaded. The self-declaration shall clearly indicate the tender enquiry number and date on which declaration is done.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- QR-11 As Per Tender Document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Average Annual Financial Turnover of the Bidder shall be equivalent to Amount Put to Tender in three preceding years 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25. Certified copies of Audited Financial Statements such as P&L Statement, Balance Sheets for the required FYs shall be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- QR-6 As Per Tender Document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Liquid Assets as on last date of previous month of tender inviting date or at a later date before submission of the bid consisting of Cash at Bank plus Term Deposits plus availability of fund based credit facilities in any Nationalized/scheduled Bank shall not be less than 25% of the amount put to tender.The cash at Bank, Bank Deposits and availability of fund based credit facilities shall be supported by a certificate issued by Nationalized/ Scheduled Bank shall be uploaded.If the Bidder has banking with more than one Bank, then the available balance liquid assets mentioned above on a particular date i.e., as on the last date of previous month of tender inviting date or any date before submission of tender shall be the same date and time for all the banks.In case of Fund Based credit facility, the certificate issued by Nationalized/ Scheduled Bank duly mentioning sanctioned limits, funds utilized so far and balance available as on the last date of previous month of tender inviting date or at a later date, before submission of the bid shall be uploaded.The certificate shall be submitted in the format as per Annexure
